name: xtool
description: Cross-platform Xcode replacement. Build and deploy iOS apps with SwiftPM on Linux, Windows, macOS.
one_liner: Lets a developer build and install iPhone apps from a Windows or Linux computer, without owning a Mac or buying Xcode.
buyer: A Windows or Linux-based indie developer or small dev shop that wants to ship an iOS app but can't justify buying a Mac just for that.
business_use_cases: A solo developer on a Windows laptop builds and ships their first iOS app without buying a Mac, lowering the cost of entering the App Store.
A CI/CD provider offers cheaper iOS build pipelines on Linux runners instead of expensive macOS cloud runners.
A coding bootcamp teaching iOS development lets students use whatever laptop they already own instead of requiring a Mac purchase.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted Linux-based iOS build/CI service that undercuts macOS cloud runner pricing, using this as the backend.
Sell a packaged 'build your first iOS app on Windows' course or template for developers who don't own a Mac.

steal_this: Stand up a cheap 'iOS build server for non-Mac developers' side service this weekend, since the Mac-cloud-runner tax is a real, well-known pain point.
